BreathLever Privacy Notice

Last updated: September 15, 2026

BreathLever stores practice and safety information on your device. It does not operate a cloud account or enable App-managed iCloud/CloudKit synchronization.

Provider and contact

BreathLever is provided by Bozhu Li (李东岳). Privacy contact: arthur.dy.lee@gmail.com. This notice describes BreathLever, not other apps from the same developer.

Information stored on your device

The App can store your declared age group, safety preferences and conditions you choose to disclose, practice history, favorites, goals, reminders, check-ins, journal entries and imported audio. It stores an acknowledgement record containing the actual health notice and terms, language, versions, content fingerprints, time and App version. Method safety confirmations are also stored locally. Acknowledgement records are not verified identity records.

We use these items to operate the features you select, apply age and safety restrictions and remember your choices. You do not need to provide an exact birthday, identity document or facial scan. The App does not upload your safety profile, journal, check-in scores or practice history to developer analytics or advertising systems.

Optional Apple features

With your separate HealthKit permission, completed sessions may be written as mindful minutes to Apple Health. You control that permission in iOS. Apple Health storage and synchronization follow your Apple settings.

The companion Watch receives an approved-method list, notice version and selected favorites from the phone, and transfers completed practice records back through WatchConnectivity. The list reflects phone eligibility checks; it does not include your age or condition details. No App-managed iCloud/CloudKit record synchronization is enabled. Device backups, Apple Health synchronization and Apple system services may still operate according to your Apple settings and policies.

Advertising, purchases and external services

For eligible adult users of the free version, Google AdMob and its consent service may process device and advertising identifiers when permitted, IP address, approximate location, ad interactions, diagnostics and consent choices to provide and measure ads, manage consent and prevent fraud. Required regional privacy choices and Apple tracking permission are handled separately. Refusing tracking does not prevent core practice access. BreathLever does not use practice or safety data to select ads.

Apple handles App Store payments; the App receives purchase entitlement information, not your payment-card details. Visiting external links exposes connection information to that site. Opening public notices uses GitHub Pages hosting. If you email support, we receive the email and any information you choose to send; avoid sending medical records. These providers may process information outside your country under their own privacy notices and applicable safeguards.

Retention, deletion and choices

Local records remain until you delete them, reset initial settings, remove the App subject to system backups, or otherwise remove them using the feature. Data export and deletion are available under Settings → Your Data. Resetting initial settings also removes local acknowledgement records and restarts onboarding. Existing Apple Health entries, Watch copies, device backups, Apple purchase records and provider-held data may need separate deletion using those services.

Where required, advertising privacy options are available under Settings → Your Data. Manage tracking and HealthKit permissions in iOS settings. Ad-provider retention and deletion are governed by its policies and your choices. We retain support correspondence only as needed to address the request and any applicable legal duties.

Children, rights and changes

BreathLever is for users aged 18 and older. A submitted underage declaration prevents access and advertising initialization. If you believe a child has used the App or sent information to us, contact us so we can assess and take appropriate action.

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, export, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, opt out of sale or sharing where applicable, and complain to a supervisory authority. Local-only data is primarily controlled from your device; contact us for data we actually hold or for assistance with a provider. We will not require information we do not need to handle the request. Updated notices show their version and date.
